name: ExampleSeenInPeriod
title: Example: patients seen in the period
description: An illustrative cohort: patients with a finished encounter that started in the period.

criteria.expression: entry.resource.ofType(Encounter).where((status = 'finished' or status = 'completed') and ((period.start >= %periodStart and period.start <= %periodEnd) or (actualPeriod.start >= %periodStart and actualPeriod.start <= %periodEnd))).exists()
